title: Implement and test slugify helper
acceptance_criterion: slugify returns a lowercase URL-safe slug, handles empty input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { slugify } from './src/slugify.js'; if (slugify('Hello, World!') !== 'hello-world' || slugify('') !== '') throw new Error('slugify behavior failed'); try { slugify(1); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/slugify.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/slugify.test.js covering normal, empty, and non-string TypeError cases.
